_comment: Methodology copy for every chart + KPI in the dashboard. Keyed by stable kebab-case methodologyKey. Each entry: { text, source, href? }. Add new charts here; pages just pass the key to MethodologyTooltip / KpiCard.

overview-protocol-tvl.text: Total Value Locked (TVL) is the dollar value of deposits sitting in Morpho Blue plus deposits held by MetaMorpho vaults that allocate into Morpho markets, summed per chain. Excludes deposits that are sitting in vaults but haven't been allocated to a market yet.

overview-protocol-share.text: Share = morpho-blue TVL ÷ (sum of TVL across morpho-blue, aave-v3, sparklend, fluid-lending, euler-v2, compound-v3) per day, on a single chain.

chains-tvl-by-chain.text: Latest daily TVL per chain, summed across morpho-blue's chainTvls entries. Hyperliquid is the L1 (chain_id 998/999).

chains-lending-share.text: Morpho's share of total on-chain lending TVL on each chain. Denominator includes every protocol DefiLlama categorizes as 'Lending' or 'CDP' on that chain.

curators-share-by-tvl.text: Each curator's share of MetaMorpho vault TVL. TVL is grouped by vaults.curator_id (Morpho's declared curator, including V2 multi-curator). 'Unattributed' = vaults where curator_id IS NULL.

curators-revenue-leaderboard.text: Estimated annual revenue per curator = (vault TVL × pre-fee APY × performance fee), annualized. Attribution uses the vault's fee_recipient_address joined to curator_addresses. 'UNATTRIBUTED' = no curator address matched the fee recipient.

curators-reach-matrix.text: Number of vaults each curator operates per chain. A cell of 0 means no vault from this curator on that chain.

curator-perf-vs-market.text: TVL-weighted net APY of all vaults under this curator vs the Morpho-wide TVL-weighted net APY (every vault). Both series are post-fee. Outperformance is the difference, in basis points.

curator-tvl-by-chain.text: This curator's vault TVL aggregated per chain per day. Stacked area; sums to the curator's total TVL.

curator-asset-class-mix.text: TVL share by underlying-asset class for vaults under this curator. Asset class is inferred from vault.asset_symbol (stablecoin, LST, LRT, BTC, ETH, RWA, other). This is a proxy: it doesn't see what the vault has actually allocated into Morpho markets — allocation-level data lives in vault_allocations_daily, which is empty until the backfill drains.

assets-class-share-time.text: Daily share of total Morpho supply USD by asset class (stablecoin, LST, LRT, BTC, ETH, RWA, other). PT-* tokens are routed to their underlying's class.

assets-stablecoin-breakdown.text: Supply USD per stablecoin loan asset across Morpho markets. Ethena's USDe + sUSDe + USDtb are highlighted to surface their combined footprint inside Morpho's stablecoin supply.
assets-stablecoin-breakdown.source: market_state_daily latest day, filtered to stablecoin loan_asset_symbols.

assets-top-collateral.text: Top collateral assets by total USD backing active borrows. Aggregated across every market on every chain.
assets-top-collateral.source: market_state_daily latest day, joined to markets.collateral_asset_symbol.

assets-chain-mix.text: Per-chain asset-class composition. Each row is a chain; each cell is the supply USD denominated in that class on that chain. Heatmap intensity per row (so each row reads as its own mix).

rates-morpho-vs-aave.text: Daily Morpho supply APY (TVL-weighted across all Morpho markets with that loan asset on that chain) vs Aave V3's supply APY for the same (asset, chain). Spread is Morpho minus Aave in basis points.

rates-supply-apy-hist.text: Distribution of Morpho market supply APYs on the latest day, bucketed (0–2%, 2–4%, ..., 20%+). Each bucket reports the count of markets and the total supply USD in it. Saturated-util IRM blow-ups (supply_apy ≥ 100%) are excluded.

rates-util-hist.text: Distribution of Morpho market utilization on the latest day, in 10-percentage-point buckets. Bar height is total supply USD in the bucket; tooltip shows market count.

rates-util-apy-scatter.text: One bubble per Morpho market with >$1M supply on the latest day. x = utilization, y = supply APY, bubble area = supply USD, color = collateral asset class. APYs ≥ 100% excluded.

rates-risk-surface.text: Top 20 markets by blast-radius score = supply USD × utilization × LLTV. High score = lots of capital, highly utilized, on a high loan-to-value market. Where a liquidation cascade would hurt most.

rates-bad-debt.text: Market-days in the last 90 days where unrealized bad debt grew more than 5% over the prior day AND exceeds $1k absolute. Each row is one such event.

vaults-tvl-distribution.text: Vault TVL distribution across 8 log-scaled buckets from <$100K to $1B+. Reveals the long tail: most vaults sit below $25M; a handful exceed $1B.

vaults-top-ten.text: Ten largest MetaMorpho vaults by latest TVL. Bar color highlights the leader; tooltip shows the vault's name, chain, net APY, and TVL.

markets-lltv-distribution.text: Distribution of supply USD across LLTV bands (0–50%, 50–70%, 70–80%, 80–90%, 90–95%, 95%+). The dominant band is where most of Morpho's capital sits in terms of loan-to-value risk. Phantom markets (APY ≥ 100%) are excluded so the weight reflects real productive capital.
